$comment: Mutation testing (constitution Article V). The mocha runner + perTest coverage re-runs only the tests covering each mutant, orders of magnitude faster than the old command runner which ran `npm test` (tsc + full suite) per mutant. buildCommand compiles the instrumented sandbox once; disableTypeChecks is scoped to src/**/*.ts so Stryker's `// @ts-nocheck` header is NOT prepended to non-source files — it used to hit docs/.vitepress/traceability.types.ts and break the S11-SR-04 banner assertion in the initial run.
